description:
After closing JMAP-6i06 (--all-features build break, mechanical 8-site fix), the remaining ready frontier is dominated by items that exceed safe-autonomous scope for a single /do-beads pass:

A. **API-break-class** (need coordinated rollout across many crates):
   - JMAP-g7wu.1.1 — CallerCtx forwarding through MailBackend (canonical, then propagate to chat/contacts/sharing)
   - JMAP-g7wu.3.1 — helpers.rs builder-struct refactor (canonical, 7-site propagation)
   - JMAP-r3pg.14 — extract_account_id signature change (~30 call sites in 7 extension-server crates)
   These all want to land together to avoid double-breakage of downstream consumers.

B. **New-crate scaffolding** (sizable design + ~20 typed sub-types each):
   - JMAP-sehw.1 — jmap-jscontact-types (22 RFC 9553 sub-types)
   - JMAP-x59i.1 — jmap-jscalendar-types (extract from calendars-types)
   - JMAP-06zp.1 — jmap-metadata-types (draft-ietf-jmap-metadata)

C. **Multi-session test coverage**:
   - JMAP-uuoi — wiremock smoke tests across 6 client crates, estimated 3000-4500 LoC

D. **Bounded but spec-heavy parser work**:
   - JMAP-g7wu.5 — 5 RFC 5322 header-form parsers (AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, AsURLs) in jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs. mime-tree does NOT expose these parsers as public functions, so this either needs (a) a new dep (email-encoding / mailparse / similar — Cargo.toml change), (b) extending mime-tree to expose its internal parsers (cross-repo change to /home/mark/PROJECT/MIME/mime-tree), or (c) implementing the 5 parsers from scratch in jmap-mail-server (hundreds of LoC, RFC 5322 ABNF compliance).

E. **Design decision with non-equivalent options**:
   - JMAP-9i53 — updatedProperties on /changes (P4, two options that ripple differently across the workspace)

**Question for human**: which of A/B/C/D/E should be the next focus, and for D specifically, which sub-option (new dep / extend mime-tree / write from scratch)?

Filed per workspace AGENTS.md 'Turn questions into beads' rule rather than invoking interactive question tool. The autonomous /do-beads loop stops at this ambiguity rather than picking a direction unilaterally.
